name: main-guard
description: A red band when you are on main or in prod, and no force-push, reset --hard or unconfirmed push to a protected branch

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names; * matches anything (release* covers release/2.1).

confirmPushes.title: Ask before a plain push
confirmPushes.description: On: a plain git push to a protected branch asks you first. Off: it is refused outright.
